lines.title: Look where the tiny marks hide
lines.text: We are Sytronsoft. Tonight, look where the tiny marks hide on jewellery.

lines.title: SytronMark-AI: hallmark and stamp recognition
lines.text: SytronMark-AI is hallmark and stamp recognition. Let's open the box.

lines.title: Inside a ring band: 916, read in seconds
lines.text: This ring keeps its mark inside the band. Purity mark nine one six, read in seconds.

lines.title: On the back of a pendant: 925
lines.text: A pendant carries its mark on the back. Nine two five.

lines.title: BIS marks, stamp marks and plated pieces
lines.text: A bangle with a B I S mark. A plated chain, stamped on its clasp. Both are read.

lines.title: Upside down, and still read
lines.text: This pendant hangs upside down. Leave it there. Any angle, even upside down.

lines.title: Each photo: sharpness and glare checked
lines.text: Shiny metal, tiny marks. Every photo is checked for sharpness and glare.

lines.title: Works offline, no internet needed
lines.text: Here the reading just goes on. SytronMark-AI works offline, no internet needed.
